title: Origin story: Thoth
description: Thoth was the ibis-headed god of wisdom, inventor of writing and reckoner of time. He gambled with the moon and won the extra five days that complete the year. He served as scribe and counselor of the gods, recording the judgment of every heart.

title: Ability profile: Thoth
description: Ranked abilities: Wisdom — rank 100/100; Writing — rank 100/100; Mathematics — rank 98/100; Magic — rank 95/100; Mediation — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Thoth
description: Powers: The invention of language made visible; Lunar reckoning — master of calendars; Spells recorded in the Book of Thoth.

title: Stamina feats: Thoth
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Records every judgment without error; Out-thought the moon itself.

title: Crossover notes: Thoth
description: Thoth crosses naturally with: wisdom, writing, magic, the moon, measurement.

title: Cultural impact: Thoth
description: Patron of scribes, scholars, and all who measure the world.

title: Generator record: Thoth
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Thoth's database.
